subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw support trusted external workspace agent-config discovery in core, or keep agent registration explicit and solve the workflow through runtime `agents.create/update/delete` and config patch APIs?
rationale: The request adds a new config surface, filesystem scanning, trust boundaries, precedence rules, and live routing/session semantics that source inspection cannot settle without maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Keep Explicit Registration
options.body: Keep `agents.list` and explicit Gateway/CLI mutation APIs as canonical, and only add smaller missing APIs if zero-restart registration remains painful.

options.title: Design Bounded Discovery
options.body: Accept the feature only after defining trusted roots, precedence, validation, startup or explicit reload semantics, security proof, and docs/tests.

options.title: Route To Operator Tooling
options.body: Leave glob discovery outside core for scripts, plugins, or ClawHub tooling unless a missing core API blocks safe implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Registration
recommendation.body: Keep `agents.list` and explicit Gateway/CLI mutation APIs as canonical, and only add smaller missing APIs if zero-restart registration remains painful.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest history signal across central agent config, gateway agent methods, and recent agent runtime ownership.
